passages.title: Text 01
passages.text: Please sit here.

passages.title: Text 02
passages.text: Happy birthday, Ana!

passages.title: Text 03
passages.text: STOP. Do not go in.

passages.title: Text 04
passages.text: Come to my party on Sunday!

passages.title: Text 05
passages.text: The library opens at eight.

passages.title: Text 06
passages.text:
Hi Rina,
Please bring your blue pen tomorrow.
— Sari

passages.title: Text 07
passages.text: Wash your hands. Then eat your lunch.

passages.title: Text 08
passages.text:
Dear Budi,
Thank you for helping me.
— Ali

passages.title: Text 09
passages.text:
School bus: 7:00 a.m.
Wait at the front gate.

passages.title: Text 10
passages.text:
Hi Dad,
I am at the school library. I will come home at four.
— Mia

passages.title: Text 11
passages.text: CAUTION: Wet floor. Walk slowly.

passages.title: Text 12
passages.text:
Hi Ben,
Can you help me carry these books? They are heavy.
— Tom

passages.title: Text 13
passages.text:
FREE DRAWING TIME
Come to Room 2 after school. Bring your pencils. Everyone can join.

passages.title: Text 14
passages.text: First, open your book. Next, read page five. Then write your name.

passages.title: Text 15
passages.text:
Hi Nita,
I cannot play today. I am sick. Let us play on Friday.
— Eko

passages.title: Text 16
passages.text:
Dear Mom,
I made a card for you. Thank you for taking care of me. I love you!
— Dina

passages.title: Text 17
passages.text:
NOTICE
The playground is closed today. The ground is wet. Please play in the hall.

passages.title: Text 18
passages.text:
Hi Lala,
We will make sandwiches at my house on Saturday. You can come at ten. Please bring a plate.
— Fina

passages.title: Text 19
passages.text:
Remember!
Our class photo is tomorrow. Wear your white shirt. Meet in Room 4 at nine.

passages.title: Text 20
passages.text:
Hi Rafi,
I have your water bottle. You left it in class. Please come to my desk after lunch and take it.
— Nino

questions.prompt: Why does the writer say this?
choices: To tell the time
To ask someone to sit
To ask someone to run
To say goodbye
questions.evidence: Please sit here.
questions.explanation: Kalimat ini meminta pembaca duduk di tempat yang ditunjuk.

questions.prompt: Why is this written?
choices: To give directions
To ask for help
To invite Ana to school
To say happy birthday
questions.evidence: Happy birthday, Ana!
questions.explanation: Penulis menyampaikan ucapan ulang tahun kepada Ana.

questions.prompt: What does the sign do?
choices: Tell people not to enter
Invite people inside
Ask people to sing
Tell people to eat
questions.evidence: Do not go in.
questions.explanation: Larangan masuk menunjukkan tujuan memperingatkan atau melarang pembaca masuk.

questions.prompt: Why does the writer write this?
choices: To explain a game
To say sorry
To invite someone to a party
To ask for water
questions.evidence: Come to my party on Sunday!
questions.explanation: Kata come dan penyebutan pesta menunjukkan undangan.

questions.prompt: Why is this written?
choices: To close the library
To invite someone home
To tell the opening time
To ask for a book
questions.evidence: The library opens at eight.
questions.explanation: Teks memberi informasi tentang jam buka perpustakaan.

questions.prompt: Why does Sari write this message?
choices: To say the pen is lost
To ask Rina to bring a pen
To sell a pen
To borrow a bag
questions.evidence: Please bring your blue pen tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Sari meminta Rina membawa pena birunya besok.

questions.prompt: Why did they write this?
choices: To give simple instructions
To describe a lunch box
To invite someone to a game
To tell a story about lunch
questions.evidence: Wash your hands. Then eat your lunch.
questions.explanation: Dua kalimat perintah memberi urutan tindakan yang harus dilakukan.

questions.prompt: Why does Ali write to Budi?
choices: To invite Budi to dinner
To tell Budi to go home
To ask Budi to help tomorrow
To thank Budi
questions.evidence: Thank you for helping me.
questions.explanation: Ungkapan thank you menunjukkan tujuan berterima kasih.

questions.prompt: Why is this notice here?
choices: To tell students when and where to wait
To describe the bus color
To ask students to wash the bus
To invite students to a party
questions.evidence:
School bus: 7:00 a.m.
Wait at the front gate.
questions.explanation: Pengumuman memberi waktu bus dan tempat menunggu.

questions.prompt: Why does Mia send this message?
choices: To invite Dad to school
To ask Dad for a book
To ask Dad to visit the library
To tell Dad where she is and when she will return
questions.evidence: I am at the school library. I will come home at four.
questions.explanation: Mia memberi kabar tentang lokasi dan waktu pulangnya.

questions.prompt: What does this sign try to do?
choices: Tell people to clean the floor
Warn people to be careful
Invite people to swim
Ask people to run
questions.evidence: Wet floor. Walk slowly.
questions.explanation: Lantai basah dan perintah berjalan pelan merupakan peringatan keselamatan.

questions.prompt: Why does Tom write to Ben?
choices: To invite Ben to buy books
To say he likes books
To ask Ben for help
To tell Ben to read a book
questions.evidence: Can you help me carry these books?
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan langsung meminta bantuan membawa buku.

questions.prompt: Why was this notice written?
choices: To invite students to draw together
To ask students to buy pencils
To explain how to draw a cat
To tell students the room is closed
questions.evidence: Come to Room 2 after school. Bring your pencils. Everyone can join.
questions.explanation: Pengumuman mengajak siswa mengikuti kegiatan menggambar.

questions.prompt: What is the writer trying to do?
choices: Invite the reader to a party
Describe a new book
Tell the reader what to do step by step
Tell a funny story
questions.evidence: First, open your book. Next, read page five. Then write your name.
questions.explanation: Urutan first, next, then dipakai untuk memberikan petunjuk langkah demi langkah.

questions.prompt: Why does Eko send this message?
choices: To invite Nita to play today
To tell Nita where the park is
To ask Nita for medicine
To explain he cannot play today and suggest Friday
questions.evidence: I cannot play today. I am sick. Let us play on Friday.
questions.explanation: Eko menjelaskan pembatalan hari ini sekaligus mengusulkan hari pengganti.

questions.prompt: What does Dina want to do with this card?
choices: Ask Mom to buy a card
Show love and say thank you
Invite Mom to a class
Tell Mom to go to school
questions.evidence: Thank you for taking care of me. I love you!
questions.explanation: Kartu menyampaikan kasih sayang dan terima kasih, bukan permintaan.

questions.prompt: Why is this notice written?
choices: To ask children to clean the hall
To tell children the playground is new
To invite children to play on the wet ground
To tell children the playground is closed and where to play
questions.evidence: The playground is closed today. The ground is wet. Please play in the hall.
questions.explanation: Teks memberitahu penutupan dan mengarahkan anak bermain di aula.

questions.prompt: Which answer best explains why Fina writes this message?
choices: To invite Lala and ask her to bring a plate
To invite Lala to make sandwiches
To ask Lala to bring a plate
To tell Lala the sandwiches are ready
questions.evidence: You can come at ten. Please bring a plate.
questions.explanation: Fina mengajak Lala datang untuk membuat sandwich sekaligus meminta Lala membawa piring. Dua tujuan itu sama-sama ada dalam pesan.

questions.prompt: Why did they write this?
choices: To invite parents to a party
To remind students how to prepare for the photo
To sell white shirts
To describe a photo
questions.evidence: Our class photo is tomorrow. Wear your white shirt. Meet in Room 4 at nine.
questions.explanation: Pesan mengingatkan kegiatan foto serta pakaian, tempat, dan waktunya.

questions.prompt: Why does Nino send this message?
choices: To invite Rafi to lunch
To say Nino lost his bottle
To tell Rafi where to collect his bottle
To ask Rafi for water
questions.evidence: I have your water bottle. You left it in class. Please come to my desk after lunch and take it.
questions.explanation: Nino memberi tahu botol Rafi ada padanya dan cara mengambilnya.
